subject: Security timebox: propose bundled slots for SOC2 / DPA / Pen-test walkthrough
messages:
From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@fintechinc.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@fintechinc.com
Date: 2028-06-12T15:15:00Z
Subject: Request: combined SOC2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — 60min options

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our security team at FinTech Inc wants to do a single walk-through that covers SOC 2 scoping, the DPA redlines we circulated, and an initial pen-test kickoff. We know that's a lot, so we'd like to propose a compact, bundled approach to keep internal attendees to a minimum.

Two 60-minute windows that work for us (PST):
- Tue 2028-06-20 10:00-11:00
- Wed 2028-06-21 14:00-15:00

Questions:
- Is it possible to do a single combined session, or would you recommend splitting pen-test kickoff from the SOC2 walk-through?
- What's the secure method you prefer for evidence transfer (SFTP, SharePoint link, or secure drive)?

I've attached our standard intake questionnaire (FinTech-questionnaire.pdf) and included our point-of-contact for procurement on the thread (security@fintechinc.com).

Thanks — Alex
Alex Jones
Head of InfoSec, FinTech Inc
alex.jones@fintechinc.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@fintechinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: combined SOC2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — 60min options

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the questionnaire.

Short answer: yes, we can bundle this into a single compact timebox if you prefer — we typically do a 45–60 minute SOC 2 + DPA orientation and then a separate ~30-minute pen-test kickoff with the vendor to cover scope and logistics. That said, we can do a single 75-minute session if your team prefers fewer calendar touches.

Proposed plan (pick one):
- Option A (bundle): 75 minutes (SOC2 + DPA orientation + pen-test high level) — good when attendees are limited.
- Option B (recommended): 45-minute SOC2/DPA orientation + 30-minute pen-test kickoff (two back-to-back slots) — keeps technical scoping for the vendor separate.

I can hold the two windows you suggested for Option B; for Option A I have a 75-minute slot on Tue 2028-06-20 10:00-11:15 PST. We use a secure transfer method (pre-authenticated S3 link or our secure SharePoint flow) — I'll send a short evidence-mapping spreadsheet that lists what we need and who to send it to.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-map.xlsx (evidence checklist) and a copy of the DPA redlines (DPA-redlines-v3.docx) — see the evidence tab for fields we need before the walkthrough.

If that looks OK I'll send calendar invites with a bridge and a short agenda. Also tagging Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (sales engineer) to join the call.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Alex — Marissa here (CS lead). Quick operational notes so the session is useful:

If you pick Option B (recommended) we'll do the following pre-work:
- FinTech to upload the completed questionnaire + any architecture diagrams to the secure S3 link I will provide 48 hours before the SOC2 orientation.
- We will pre-map the evidence fields in the SOC2-evidence-map.xlsx so reviewers know which artifacts to request during the call.
- Pen-test vendor: please add the vendor contact to the thread if you want them to join live for the kickoff. Otherwise we'll schedule a vendor-only 30-min technical session.

Proposed confirmed times (PST):
- SOC2/DPA orientation: Tue 2028-06-20 10:00-10:45 (we'll use this for policy and control mapping)
- Pen-test kickoff (vendor only): Tue 2028-06-20 10:50-11:20 or Wed 2028-06-21 14:00-14:30 (pick which vendor slot works)

I will send the secure upload link and a short agenda once you confirm which slot you prefer. Also looping Karthik for any model-level performance questions they might want addressed during the orientation.

Thanks — Marissa
